data.long_meaning: The name Belden is derived from Old English 'bealden' meaning 'hill, mound, bold, or brave'. This name was given to a child who was thought to have the qualities of bravery and strength, much like a hill that stands tall and unyielding. The name Belden carries the meaning “Brave hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belden usually hope their child will grow to embody brave hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
